premise: At sunset Flower folds up her petals and Snail thinks she's sad, so he stays with her all night by Firefly's light — and in the morning Flower opens wide: she was only sleeping.
inspiration: The faithful watcher of folk tales who keeps vigil through the night, turned: the worry was needless, and the kindness still counts.
lesson: Staying close is a kind thing to do, even when nothing is wrong.
learning: Some flowers fold their petals up at night and open again in the morning sun.

en-US.title: Flower Closes for the Night
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] The sun was going down. {flower:enter} Flower glowed in the golden light. {snail:enter} {snail:go to flower} Snail crawled up beside her, to tell her all about his day. But Flower {flower:live close hold} folded up her petals, tight as a bud. {snail:face surprised} [nervously] "Flower? Are you sad?" No answer. {snail:face sad} {snail:live talk} [warmly] "Then I'll stay with you," said Snail. "All night long." {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} Up came the moon. Along came {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to flower} Firefly. {firefly:face happy} "I'll stay too," she said, and {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} glowed like a little lantern. {snail:face normal} So Snail {snail:live talk} told Flower all about his day, very, very slowly. [yawns] Then {snail:live hide hold} he tucked into his shell, right beside her. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} {sfx:birds} In the morning, up came the sun. {flower:live close resume} Flower opened wide. {flower:face happy} "Good morning, Snail!" {snail:live hide resume} Snail peeked out. [surprised] "You were only sleeping?" {flower:live talk} "Flowers fold up at night," said Flower, "and open in the sun." {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] "Then I'll tell you my day every evening," said Snail, "before you close."

es-ES.title: Buenas noches, Flor
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] El sol se estaba poniendo. {flower:enter} Flor brillaba con la luz dorada de la tarde. {snail:enter} {snail:go to flower} Caracol se acercó hasta ella para contarle su día. Pero Flor {flower:live close hold} recogió los pétalos y se quedó cerradita como un capullo. {snail:face surprised} [nervously] —¿Flor? ¿Estás triste? No contestó. {snail:face sad} {snail:live talk} [warmly] —Pues me quedo contigo —dijo Caracol—. Toda la noche. {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} Salió la luna. Y llegó {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to flower} Luciérnaga. {firefly:face happy} —Yo también me quedo —dijo, y {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} brilló como un farolillo. {snail:face normal} Así que Caracol {snail:live talk} le contó a Flor todo su día, muy, muy despacito. [yawns] Luego {snail:live hide hold} se metió en su concha, a su ladito. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} {sfx:birds} Por la mañana salió el sol. {flower:live close resume} Flor se abrió de par en par. {flower:face happy} —¡Buenos días, Caracol! {snail:live hide resume} Caracol asomó la cabeza. [surprised] —¿Solo estabas dormida? {flower:live talk} —Las flores nos cerramos por la noche —dijo Flor— y nos abrimos con el sol. {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] —Entonces te contaré mi día todas las tardes —dijo Caracol—, antes de que te cierres.

ja-JP.title: お花の おやすみ
ja-JP.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}[softly]おひさまが、しずんでいきます。{flower:enter}お花は、金いろのひかりのなかで、きらきら。{snail:enter}{snail:go to flower}カタツムリくんが、きょうのことをはなしに、そばまでやってきました。ところがお花は、{flower:live close hold}花びらをきゅっとたたんで、つぼみみたい。{snail:face surprised}[nervously]「ねえ、かなしいの？」 へんじがありません。{snail:face sad}{snail:live talk}[warmly]「じゃあ、ぼくがそばにいるよ。ひとばんじゅう。」 {canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}おつきさまがのぼりました。そこへ{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to flower}ホタルさん。{firefly:face happy}「わたしもいる」 と、{firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A}小さなちょうちんみたいに、ぽうっ。{snail:face normal}カタツムリくんは、{snail:live talk}きょうのことを、ゆっくり、ゆーっくりはなしました。[yawns]それから、{snail:live hide hold}お花のすぐそばで、からにもぐりました。{canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s}{sfx:birds}朝になって、おひさまがのぼると、{flower:live close resume}お花がぱあっとひらきました。{flower:face happy}「おはよう、カタツムリくん！」 {snail:live hide resume}カタツムリくんが、そっとのぞきます。[surprised]「ねてただけなの？」 {flower:live talk}「わたしみたいなお花はね、よるはとじて、おひさまがでたらひらくの。」 {snail:face happy}{snail:hearts}[happily]「じゃあ、まいばん、とじるまえに、ぼくの一日をはなすね。」

de-DE.title: Gute Nacht, Blume
de-DE.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] Die Sonne ging unter. {flower:enter} Die Blume leuchtete im goldenen Licht. {snail:enter} {snail:go to flower} Die Schnecke kroch zu ihr hin, um ihr alles von ihrem Tag zu erzählen. Aber die Blume {flower:live close hold} faltete ihre Blütenblätter zusammen, fest wie eine Knospe. {snail:face surprised} [nervously] „Blume? Bist du traurig?“ Keine Antwort. {snail:face sad} {snail:live talk} [warmly] „Dann bleibe ich bei dir“, sagte die Schnecke. „Die ganze Nacht.“ {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} Der Mond ging auf. Da kam {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to flower} das Glühwürmchen. {firefly:face happy} „Ich bleibe auch“, sagte es und {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} leuchtete wie eine kleine Laterne. {snail:face normal} Also {snail:live talk} erzählte die Schnecke der Blume von ihrem ganzen Tag, ganz, ganz langsam. [yawns] Dann {snail:live hide hold} zog sie sich in ihr Haus zurück, direkt neben der Blume. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} {sfx:birds} Am Morgen ging die Sonne auf. {flower:live close resume} Die Blume öffnete sich weit. {flower:face happy} „Guten Morgen, Schnecke!“ {snail:live hide resume} Die Schnecke lugte heraus. [surprised] „Du hast nur geschlafen?“ {flower:live talk} „Blumen wie ich machen nachts zu“, sagte die Blume, „und in der Sonne wieder auf.“ {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] „Dann erzähle ich dir jeden Abend von meinem Tag“, sagte die Schnecke, „bevor du zumachst.“

fr-FR.title: Bonne nuit, Fleur
fr-FR.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] Le soleil se couchait. {flower:enter} Fleur brillait dans la lumière dorée. {snail:enter} {snail:go to flower} Escargot s’est approché d’elle pour lui raconter toute sa journée. Mais Fleur {flower:live close hold} a refermé ses pétales, serrés comme un bouton. {snail:face surprised} [nervously] « Fleur ? Tu es triste ? » Pas de réponse. {snail:face sad} {snail:live talk} [warmly] « Alors je reste avec toi, a dit Escargot. Toute la nuit. » {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} La lune s’est levée. Et voilà {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to flower} Luciole. {firefly:face happy} « Moi aussi, je reste », a-t-elle dit, et {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} elle a brillé comme une petite lanterne. {snail:face normal} Alors Escargot {snail:live talk} a raconté sa journée à Fleur, très, très lentement. [yawns] Puis {snail:live hide hold} il s’est blotti dans sa coquille, tout contre elle. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} {sfx:birds} Au matin, le soleil s’est levé. {flower:live close resume} Fleur s’est ouverte en grand. {flower:face happy} « Bonjour, Escargot ! » {snail:live hide resume} Escargot a sorti ses cornes. [surprised] « Tu dormais, c’est tout ? » {flower:live talk} « Les fleurs se ferment la nuit, a dit Fleur, et s’ouvrent au soleil. » {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] « Alors je te raconterai ma journée tous les soirs, a dit Escargot, avant que tu te fermes. »

it-IT.title: Buonanotte, Fiore
it-IT.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] Il sole stava tramontando. {flower:enter} Fiore splendeva nella luce dorata della sera. {snail:enter} {snail:go to flower} Chiocciola si è avvicinata piano piano, per raccontargli tutta la sua giornata. Ma Fiore {flower:live close hold} ha chiuso i petali, stretto stretto come un bocciolo. {snail:face surprised} [nervously] «Fiore? Sei triste?» Nessuna risposta. {snail:face sad} {snail:live talk} [warmly] «Allora resto con te», ha detto Chiocciola. «Tutta la notte.» {canvas:night 0.7} {sfx:crickets} È sorta la luna. Ed è arrivata {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to flower} Lucciola. {firefly:face happy} «Resto anch'io», ha detto, e {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} si è accesa come una piccola lanterna. {snail:face normal} Così Chiocciola {snail:live talk} ha raccontato a Fiore tutta la sua giornata, piano, piano, pianissimo. [yawns] Poi {snail:live hide hold} si è ritirata nel guscio, proprio accanto a lui. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s} {sfx:birds} La mattina dopo è sorto il sole. {flower:live close resume} Fiore si è aperto tutto. {flower:face happy} «Buongiorno, Chiocciola!» {snail:live hide resume} Chiocciola ha fatto capolino. [surprised] «Stavi solo dormendo?» {flower:live talk} «Noi fiori ci chiudiamo di notte», ha detto Fiore, «e ci riapriamo al sole.» {snail:face happy} {snail:hearts} [happily] «Allora ti racconterò la mia giornata tutte le sere», ha detto Chiocciola, «prima che ti chiuda.»

zh-TW.title: 小花晚上合起來
zh-TW.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}[softly]太陽要下山了。{flower:enter}小花在金黃色的光裡閃閃發亮。{snail:enter}{snail:go to flower}蝸牛爬到她旁邊，想把今天的事全都告訴她。可是小花{flower:live close hold}把花瓣合了起來，合得緊緊的，像一個花苞。{snail:face surprised}[nervously]「小花？你不開心嗎？」 小花沒有回答。{snail:face sad}{snail:live talk}[warmly]「那我陪著你。」 蝸牛說，「陪你一整個晚上。」 {canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}月亮升起來了。{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to flower}螢火蟲飛來了。{firefly:face happy}「我也陪你。」 牠說完，{firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A}亮得像一盞小燈籠。{snail:face normal}於是蝸牛{snail:live talk}把今天的事，慢慢的、慢慢的，全都說給小花聽。[yawns]接著，牠{snail:live hide hold}縮進殼裡，就睡在她旁邊。{canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s}{sfx:birds}早上，太陽出來了。{flower:live close resume}小花把花瓣張得開開的。{flower:face happy}「早安，蝸牛！」 {snail:live hide resume}蝸牛探出頭來。[surprised]「原來你只是在睡覺？」 {flower:live talk}「像我這樣的花，晚上會合起來，」 小花說，「太陽出來，就打開。」 {snail:face happy}{snail:hearts}[happily]「那我每天傍晚，」 蝸牛說，「都要在你合起來以前，把我的一天說給你聽。」

zh-HK.title: 晚安，小花
zh-HK.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7}[softly]太陽快要下山了。{flower:enter}小花在金黃色的陽光裏閃閃發亮。{snail:enter}{snail:go to flower}蝸牛爬到她身邊，想把今天發生的事全都告訴她。可是小花{flower:live close hold}把花瓣合了起來，合得緊緊的，像一個花蕾。{snail:face surprised}[nervously]「小花？你係咪唔開心呀？」 小花沒有回答。{snail:face sad}{snail:live talk}[warmly]「咁我陪住你，」 蝸牛說，「陪你成晚。」 {canvas:night 0.7}{sfx:crickets}月亮升起來了。{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to flower}螢火蟲也飛來了。{firefly:face happy}「我都陪你。」 牠說完，{firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A}像一盞小燈籠般亮着。{snail:face normal}於是蝸牛{snail:live talk}把今天的事，慢慢地、慢慢地，全部說給小花聽。[yawns]然後，牠{snail:live hide hold}縮進殼裏，就睡在她旁邊。{canvas:sunshine 0.8 20s}{sfx:birds}到了早上，太陽出來了。{flower:live close resume}小花把花瓣張得大大的。{flower:face happy}「早晨，蝸牛！」 {snail:live hide resume}蝸牛探出頭來。[surprised]「原來你只係瞓着咗？」 {flower:live talk}「好多花都係咁，夜晚會合埋，」 小花說，「有太陽就會打開。」 {snail:face happy}{snail:hearts}[happily]「咁我每日黃昏，」 蝸牛說，「都喺你合埋之前，講我嘅一日畀你聽。」
